mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year indicates inflationary pressure, leading to potential monetary tightening by the Federal Reserve, which in turn can cause negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not correlate with negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently higher costs for businesses, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% does not correlate with negative 60-day forward returns in > 55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates growing demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic expansion and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increase does not correlate with positive 5-day forward returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a contraction in the supply side of the economy, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM < 0% does not correlate with negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a strong labor market, which can boost consumer spending and lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the joint condition of PAYEMS MoM > 0% and UNRATE MoM < 0% does not correlate with positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy, which can lead to increased investment and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS MoM < 0% does not correlate with positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS YoY > 3% does not correlate with positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in GDP (GDPC1) signals an economic slowdown, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 QoQ < 0% does not correlate with negative 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.
